title: XMLFOREST (SQL) | InterSystems SQL Reference | InterSystems IRIS Data Platform 2026.1

examples.sql: SELECT Name,XMLFOREST(Name) AS ExportName FROM Sample.Person
SELECT XMLFOREST(Home_City, Home_State AS Home_State, AVG(Age) AS AvAge) AS ExportData FROM Sample.Person
SELECT XMLFOREST(name AS Para,Notes AS Para) AS XMLJobHistory FROM Sample.Employee
SELECT XMLFOREST(Name,DOB,Age, (SELECT XMLFOREST(Name,DOB) FROM Sample.Person WHERE %ID=2) AS ExportName) FROM Sample.Person where %ID=1
